name: Shuffle Planes
description: Port of FFmpeg's shuffleplanes filter: reorder or duplicate the color channels (R, G, B, A).

params.name: map0
params.description: Source channel (0 = R, 1 = G, 2 = B, 3 = A) of the output R channel

params.name: map1
params.description: Source channel of the output G channel

params.name: map2
params.description: Source channel of the output B channel

params.name: map3
params.description: Source channel of the output A channel
